log: feat: baseline diplomacy for any ruleset (#1)
feat: unit support by government, with free units and per-unit-type exemptions (#1)
feat: a player's lifecycle: joining, seating, starting units, sight and defeat (#1)

Civ1's unit support rules now use base-government-unit-support's functions, with the same rule ids, numbers, order and yields, so Civ2 can share the mechanism (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008, L5). Nothing changes in play.

Stance, wouldGoToWar, the meeting and its steps, standing, declareWar, exchanged, contact on moving and the sham peace dropped at turn start now wrap base-diplomacy (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008, lift L26). Rule ids, order, numbers and dialogues are unchanged, and every old module path still exports what it did.

Adding a player, seating players at their start tiles, the starting units, revealing tiles, refreshing player tiles and defeat now use base-player's functions, with the same rule ids, numbers and order; lib/addPlayer and Rules/TileImprovement/lib/updatePlayerTiles re-export them (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008, L27). Nothing changes in play.
